verticalDatum: Official tile EPSG25832 / DHHN2016 height EPSG7837; 2024-03-15 metadata reference date, acquisition date not independently verified.

sources.encoding: Float32 actual ground elevations; bounded lossless crop of official DGM1 tile.

method: Bilinear sample of official one-meter Float32 ground into signed two-meter native grid. Buildings and bridges are absent from DGM; cells beneath them are interpolated, not floor measurements.
limitations: One/two-meter grids are not survey accuracy. Steep rock and terrain below buildings may be interpolated. Current terrace, court and entrance levels are reconstructed from surrounding open ground. No whole-site ground replacement.

Working court1.6368m is0.22m above maximum sampled open court control; building floors are estimated from surrounding ground, not surveyed threshold heights.

Bridge endpoints and paved north route follow fresh map geometry; the source DGM excludes bridges. The suspended approach uses reconstructed parapets and end supports, with no invented measured central arch.

Outbuilding floors and widths are separately reconstructed from fresh mapped footprints and owner plans/photos. No whole-site slab, excavated ground cutout, trees, distant ruined outer ward or navigable interiors.
